capability: Retain failed .NET test projects' canonical evidence (coverage only after the passing-evidence normalization), name their failed tests in the job log and step summary, and name each producer's evidence artifact with a verifiable run attempt so the finalizer verifies each producer's newest attempt
searchEvidence: rg -n 'def verify_ci_dotnet_test_shard|def publish_ci_dotnet_artifact|def finalize_ci_dotnet_evidence|def require_ci_dotnet_artifact_roots|def canonicalize_dotnet_project_reports_from_files|def normalize_ci_dotnet_coverage_reports|upload-artifact|download-artifact' scripts .github/workflows: the existing owners are verify_ci_dotnet_test_shard (per-project failure handling), canonicalize_dotnet_project_reports_from_files and normalize_ci_dotnet_coverage_reports (coverage pairing and runner-path normalization), publish_ci_dotnet_artifact (closed upload staging), require_ci_dotnet_artifact_roots and finalize_ci_dotnet_evidence (artifact selection and aggregate verdict) and the dotnet-build/dotnet-test evidence upload and dotnet download steps in ci.yml; there is no second evidence, normalization, summary or aggregation path to reuse or retire.

Diagnosis in docs/handoff/1.1.13.md (CI core-shard diagnosis) and BUG-20260925-core-shard-intermittent-failure: the ordinary-failure branch of verify_ci_dotnet_test_shard records only the error and continues, so a failed project's discovery, TRX and coverage never enter evidence_paths or the manifest files map; run() writes VSTest output (stdout with stderr merged) only to shard.log, so the job log shows only the non-zero exit.

H5 (commander diagnosis): after Re-run failed jobs the aggregate job picked the stale attempt-1 evidence artifact in 2 of 5 reruns, so an earlier attempt's artifacts stay listed to a later attempt's jobs and actions/download-artifact with a pattern keeps one artifact per name (latest: true). First design review F-1 (P1): overwrite: true only replaces a same-name artifact; it cannot show that the finalizer verified the newest attempt, and an older successful manifest would pass the SHA, SDK and success checks. Revised design: producers upload dotnet-build-evidence-attempt-<n> and dotnet-test-<shard>-evidence-attempt-<n> (github.run_attempt) and record runId/runAttempt in the manifest; the finalizer downloads every attempt, requires the download step outcome to be success (a partial download could hide a newest attempt), and verifies each producer's highest attempt, so producers that Re-run failed jobs did not re-run keep their earlier attempt. The design relies only on the listing behavior H5 already showed, plus unique names; downloading only the current attempt would lose the carried producers, and overwrite is dropped because a per-attempt name has nothing to replace. Not taken: the REST jobs/artifacts API (needs actions: read and a token in the finalizer) and job outputs (the dotnet-test matrix legs share one output map). Neither action README documents cross-attempt listing, so the claim stays pending a controlled real re-run.

First design review F-2 (P1): failed coverage now reuses canonicalize_dotnet_project_reports_from_files and normalize_ci_dotnet_coverage_reports unchanged (the rules and rejections of passing evidence) and is omitted when either fails; only discovered-tests.txt and test-results.trx at the project's results root are kept besides that pair. F-4 (P2): focused tests cover extra file names, a second TRX, a reparse point, a malformed TRX, partial, divergent and invalid coverage, absolute source paths inside and outside the repository, attempt selection with carried producers, provenance mismatches and a failed download; deliberate regressions (unnormalized failed coverage, oldest-attempt selection, unchecked provenance) each fail those tests.

F-3 decided by the owner (decision 41, 2026-09-26): the failed TRX is uploaded unchanged (option i). Its error messages, stack traces and test output are the text VSTest's console logger already writes to shard.log, which every shard uploads, and passing projects' uploaded TRX already carry test output; theory display names with arguments are already in shard.log and the uploaded discovery lists. Option ii (redact the TRX Output elements before upload) was rejected: it lowers no exposure while shard.log keeps the same text, and a malformed TRX could not be redacted. The tests pin the byte-identical TRX upload and that the job log and step summary carry no TRX message text.

Second design review (codex/gpt-6-sol, 2026-09-26, ACCEPT-WITH-CHANGES) new P2: raw exception text in the public omission notes could carry runner or source paths. The job log and step summary now give only fixed reasons (CI_COVERAGE_NOT_PAIRED, CI_COVERAGE_NOT_NORMALIZED, CI_FAILURE_EVIDENCE_REJECTED); the raw exception text is appended only to the shard's own shard.log, the existing diagnostic log that already holds the VSTest output and command lines, and the shard error names a rejected failure-evidence directory by its fixed reason. Tests with absolute runner-root and source-path sentinels check the job log and step summary, and a deliberate leak of the raw text into the notes fails them. The shard error keeps its existing raw text for the project's own failure (for example the failed command line). Third review (codex/gpt-6-sol, 2026-09-26, P2): the contract and the CI document now limit this guarantee to the new failed-test report and omission notes, name the two existing raw channels (the combined project-failure message and the stderr line when the step summary cannot be written), and state that shard.log is an allowlisted public artifact, not a confidential location; no code changed.

terminalContract: A failed test shard still publishes, through the unchanged closed upload staging, each failed project's discovered-tests.txt and test-results.trx from its results root, byte-unchanged, and one coverage.json/coverage.cobertura.xml pair only when it passes the unchanged passing-evidence pairing and runner-path normalization; coverage that fails either rule is omitted and every other file (dumps, logs, extra TRX, non-canonical attachments) stays out. A reparse point or non-regular entry in a failed project's results directory uploads nothing from that project and adds the fixed failure-evidence reason to the shard error. The shard manifest keeps success false and lists only passing projects in projects, and the shard still fails with its combined error. The shard's new failed-test report in the job log and GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY names each failed project with its failed TRX test names (at most 50, control characters and backticks replaced) and a fixed reason for each omitted evidence item; that report and its omission notes never carry TRX messages, test output or raw exception text, and the raw omission diagnostic, which can hold runner or source paths, is appended to that shard's uploaded shard.log, an allowlisted public artifact rather than a confidential location. This guarantee covers only the new report and omission notes: two existing channels can still put raw exception text in the job log, namely the shard's combined failure message for a failed project (for example its failed command line) and the stderr line printed when the step summary cannot be written. Owner decision 41 (2026-09-26): the uploaded failed TRX keeps its error messages, stack traces and test output unchanged (option i; the same text is already in the uploaded shard.log); redaction (option ii) was rejected. Evidence manifests become schema 3 and add runId and runAttempt from GITHUB_RUN_ID and GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT. The producers upload dotnet-build-evidence-attempt-<n> and dotnet-test-<shard>-evidence-attempt-<n> with n = github.run_attempt and no overwrite; the dotnet job downloads dotnet-*-evidence-attempt-* and passes the download step outcome to the finalizer, which fails unless it is success. The finalizer rejects unknown or malformed artifact names and attempts above the current run attempt, requires an artifact for every producer, selects each producer's highest downloaded attempt, requires the selected manifest's runId to equal GITHUB_RUN_ID and its runAttempt to equal that attempt, and names a selected failed-producer manifest beside a successful producer job as missing newest evidence before its other checks. Cross-attempt selection is not verified: it is pending a controlled real GitHub re-run, and until that evidence exists a failed run is followed by a new workflow run, not Re-run failed jobs. Upload and download paths, retention, if-no-files-found, jobs, permissions, action pins, stable check names, verifier commands, test selection, timeouts, coverage thresholds and every other finalizer rule are unchanged; no retry, skip, product, firmware, package or release behavior changes.
